patches.name: Shuffle+
patches.description: Long-press Now Playing's shuffle button to play the current playlist, album or Liked Songs in a truly random (Fisher-Yates, SecureRandom) order, with Spotify's own shuffle off.

options.description: A tap on the shuffle button runs Shuffle+ too, instead of Spotify's own shuffle.
Turning shuffle on from Android Auto or any other control runs Shuffle+ instead of Spotify's own shuffle.
Songs played in the last N hours go to the end of a shuffle. 0 turns this off.

repoDescription: True random shuffle for Spotify Android (Morphe patch, based on spicetify/morphe-patches)
